c— calculates spline coefficients for periodic function c— the interval must be closed, i.e. x(n)-x(1)=periodlength and y(n)=y(1)

c– input:

c- n: number of x,y-values, must be at least five c- x: array of x-values c- y: array of y-values

c– ouput:

c- ypp: spline-coefficients c- ifail: error status
